title: Blockmind AI
tagline: Abstracting away the complexities of blockchain with one chatbot. The ultimate location for all of your blockchain questions and struggles!
description: Blockmind AI is a smart AI assistant that leverages AI technology to abstract the complexities of blockchain. By using DAO decentralized voting to fine tune GPT, we are able to set up an end-to-end pipeline to support users that want to mint NFTs, transfer tokens, analyze market trends or wallet features, audit/create smart contracts, deploy and validate etherscan transactions, and more!
how_its_made: Blockmind AI uses Polygon and Worldcoin ID for anonymous authorization, GPT-4 LLMs with LangChain and Faiss embeddings for the model training, Hardhat and Alchemy + Tenderly for forking the Ethereum mainnet, Verbwire and Quicknode for NFT mints, Nouns DAO for art assets, IPFS/Filecoin to store decentralied NFT images, Gnosis and Metamask for send/swap/fund, the Graph and Airstack for market and collection queries, and the T3 stack (Next.JS, Prisma, TRPC, Next Auth, Tailwind) for the full stack web app demo.
